title: mCPT at SemEval-2023 Task 3: Multilingual Label-Aware Contrastive Pre-Training of Transformers for Few- and Zero-shot Framing Detection
reasoning: The paper describes a system for framing detection in news articles as part of a SemEval competition. While one of the detected frames in the referenced taxonomy is 'morality', the paper's focus is on the technical implementation and performance of a multi-label classification system using contrastive learning, not on evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics themselves. The ethics statement and limitations sections are standard and do not constitute a core research component according to the instructions.
